flags.why: The pronoun refers to a man, rather than a woman or any distant person, as recorded in the [dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=v%E1%BA%A3).
flags.fix: he; that man (a man of similar age or slightly older than the speaker)

flags.why: This is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label ([source](https://www.vjol.info/ngop-la-gi)).
The eating sense is also used in Northern Vietnamese, so the Central and Southern restriction is misleading ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/an-hang-eWtW3fDV7O9QM.html)).
“Giờ làm cảm” is not natural Vietnamese for saying that someone has caught a cold.
flags.fix: Nó ngồi vọc nước cả buổi, giờ bị cảm.
